description: The shipped meeting-notes window may run one local meeting flow: check readiness, request the two capture permissions, start, pause, resume, and stop a meeting, name a meeting, edit an operator note, record optional pre-meeting context, copy a transcript, manage exact local vocabulary replacements without rewriting retained transcript bytes, correct a displayed speaker name without rewriting the retained transcript, restore a verified withheld transcript turn without rewriting the source artifact, compare a source-bound retry candidate and either keep the current transcript or promote that candidate, open only the verified transcript file the operator selected, play only a freshly verified retained microphone or system recording through a fixed native player, release a selected recording, delete a confirmed transcript and its generated notes, move a confirmed meeting to local Trash, list what is currently in Trash, restore a meeting from Trash within its 30-day window, open local completed notes with retained source passages, regenerate a meeting note from its current transcript, export a reviewed meeting as plain files and a compact archive written only inside that meeting's own directory, put one meeting behind a local-access lock and remove that lock after macOS confirms the device owner, obtain one single-use confirmation for one action on one locked meeting, receive the local note-capture-hotkey focus event while a meeting is recording, dismiss the once-only first-run sheet, and search across meetings only while the operator's local probe marker exists on this Mac. It cannot use generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.
